fullText.simplified:
一个小兵

    刘要看到孙策脸都白了，他害怕得从马上掉了下来。助手没有帮他，马上跑了，刘要没办法，跟着助手也跑了。他们带着一些人跑回到曲阿城外，孙策的人跟在后面。
    刘要还想跑，有个人站出来，对他说：“大人，您不能再跑了。孙策的人不多，我们可以和他打，不用害怕！”
    刘要的眼睛都大了，问道：“你是谁？我怎么不认识你？”
    那个人说：“大人，我叫太史慈，是个小兵。”
    “小兵？”刘要有点儿想笑：“一个小兵也敢和孙策打？你想死吗？”
    太史慈说：“大人，我敢和孙策打，我不怕他！”
    刘要一点儿都不想听，他的家已经没有了，他累极了，说：“你想死就去吧。”
    太史慈知道刘要不相信他，但是他真的不怕孙策，也很想和孙策打。他心想，等打败孙策，刘要就会相信他的。
    太史慈拿着刀，骑着马，一个人跑到孙策的军队前面。他大声问道：“谁是孙策？”
    孙策站出来，看了看他，问：“你是谁？”
    太史慈说：“我叫太史慈，来打孙策！”
    孙策大笑：“我就是孙策，来，我和你打！我不怕你！”
    太史慈说：“我也不怕你！”
    两个人打在了一起。
    孙策的助手和军队都站在旁边，他们不敢帮忙，因为孙策不让他们帮忙，孙策要自己和太史慈打。天气很热，他们从山上打到山下，从中午打到晚上，衣服坏了，头发乱了，刀也掉了，但是两个人都很厉害，谁也不能打败谁。
    孙策越打越高兴，他拉着太史慈的衣服，大笑着说：“你这个人真有意思！”
    太史慈也拉着孙策的头发，大声说：“你这个人真没意思！”
    孙策笑得更大声了，他觉得太史慈太有意思了。
fullText.traditional:
一個小兵

    劉要看到孫策臉都白了，他害怕得從馬上掉了下來。助手沒有幫他，馬上跑了，劉要沒辦法，跟著助手也跑了。他們帶著一些人跑回到曲阿城外，孫策的人跟在後面。
    劉要還想跑，有個人站出來，對他說：“大人，您不能再跑了。孫策的人不多，我們可以和他打，不用害怕！”
    劉要的眼睛都大了，問道：“你是誰？我怎麼不認識你？”
    那個人說：“大人，我叫太史慈，是個小兵。”
    “小兵？”劉要有點兒想笑：“一個小兵也敢和孫策打？你想死嗎？”
    太史慈說：“大人，我敢和孫策打，我不怕他！”
    劉要一點兒都不想聽，他的家已經沒有了，他累極了，說：“你想死就去吧。”
    太史慈知道劉要不相信他，但是他真的不怕孫策，也很想和孫策打。他心想，等打敗孫策，劉要就會相信他的。
    太史慈拿著刀，騎著馬，一個人跑到孫策的軍隊前面。他大聲問道：“誰是孫策？”
    孫策站出來，看了看他，問：“你是誰？”
    太史慈說：“我叫太史慈，來打孫策！”
    孫策大笑：“我就是孫策，來，我和你打！我不怕你！”
    太史慈說：“我也不怕你！”
    兩個人打在了一起。
    孫策的助手和軍隊都站在旁邊，他們不敢幫忙，因為孫策不讓他們幫忙，孫策要自己和太史慈打。天氣很熱，他們從山上打到山下，從中午打到晚上，衣服壞了，頭髮亂了，刀也掉了，但是兩個人都很厲害，誰也不能打敗誰。
    孫策越打越高興，他拉著太史慈的衣服，大笑著說：“你這個人真有意思！”
    太史慈也拉著孫策的頭髮，大聲說：“你這個人真沒意思！”
    孫策笑得更大聲了，他覺得太史慈太有意思了。

sentences.traditional: 劉要看到孫策臉都白了，他害怕得從馬上掉了下來。

sentences.english: When Liu Yao saw Sun Ce, his face went pale. He was so scared that he fell off his horse.

sentences.traditional: 助手沒有幫他，馬上跑了，劉要沒辦法，跟著助手也跑了。
sentences.pinyin: zhù shǒu méi yǒu bāng tā mǎ shàng pǎo le liú yào méi bàn fǎ gēn zhe zhù shǒu yě pǎo le
sentences.english: The assistants did not help him and immediately ran away. Liu Yao has no choice but to run away with the assistants.

sentences.simplified: 他们带着一些人跑回到曲阿城外，孙策的人跟在后面。
sentences.traditional: 他們帶著一些人跑回到曲阿城外，孫策的人跟在後面。
sentences.pinyin: tā men dài zhe yì xiē rén pǎo huí dào qǔ ā chéng wài sūn cè de rén gēn zài hòu miàn
sentences.english: They ran back to the outside of the city of Qu’a, taking some men with them, with Sun Ce’s men following behind.

sentences.simplified: 刘要还想跑，有个人站出来，对他说：“大人，您不能再跑了。
sentences.traditional: 劉要還想跑，有個人站出來，對他說：“大人，您不能再跑了。
sentences.pinyin: liú yào hái xiǎng pǎo yǒu ge rén zhàn chu lai duì tā shuō dà ren nín bù néng zài pǎo le
sentences.english: Liu Yao still wanted to run when someone stepped forward and said, “Lord, you must not run any longer.

sentences.simplified: 孙策的人不多，我们可以和他打，不用害怕！”
sentences.traditional: 孫策的人不多，我們可以和他打，不用害怕！”
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè de rén bù duō wǒ men kě yǐ hé tā dǎ bú yòng hài pà
sentences.english: Sun Ce doesn’t have many men. We can fight them. Don’t be scared!”

sentences.simplified: 刘要的眼睛都大了，问道：“你是谁？我怎么不认识你？”
sentences.traditional: 劉要的眼睛都大了，問道：“你是誰？我怎麼不認識你？”
sentences.pinyin: liú yào de yǎn jing dōu dà le wèn dào nǐ shì shéi wǒ zěn me bú rèn shi nǐ
sentences.english: Liu Yao’s eyes widened. He asked, “Who are you? Why don’t I know who you are?”

sentences.simplified: 那个人说：“大人，我叫太史慈，是个小兵。”
sentences.traditional: 那個人說：“大人，我叫太史慈，是個小兵。”
sentences.pinyin: nà ge rén shuō dà ren wǒ jiào tài shǐ cí shì ge xiǎo bīng
sentences.english: That person said, “Lord, my name is Taishi Ci. I am a young soldier.”

sentences.simplified: “小兵？”刘要有点儿想笑：“一个小兵也敢和孙策打？你想死吗？”
sentences.traditional: “小兵？”劉要有點兒想笑：“一個小兵也敢和孫策打？你想死嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo bīng liú yào yǒu diǎn'r xiǎng xiào yí ge xiǎo bīng yě gǎn hé sūn cè dǎ nǐ xiǎng sǐ ma
sentences.english: “A young soldier?” Liu Yao wanted to laugh: “A young soldier, and you still dare to fight Sun Ce? Do you want to die?”

sentences.simplified: 太史慈说：“大人，我敢和孙策打，我不怕他！”
sentences.traditional: 太史慈說：“大人，我敢和孫策打，我不怕他！”
sentences.pinyin: tài shǐ cí shuō dà ren wǒ gǎn hé sūn cè dǎ wǒ bú pà tā
sentences.english: Taishi Ci said, “Lord, I do dare fight Sun Ce. I’m not scared of him!”

sentences.simplified: 刘要一点儿都不想听，他的家已经没有了，他累极了，
sentences.traditional: 劉要一點兒都不想聽，他的家已經沒有了，他累極了，
sentences.pinyin: liú yào yì diǎn'r dōu bù xiǎng tīng tā de jiā yǐ jīng méi yǒu le tā lèi jí le
sentences.english: Liu Yao didn’t want to hear this. His home was already gone, and he was extremely tired.

sentences.simplified: 说：“你想死就去吧。”
sentences.traditional: 說：“你想死就去吧。”
sentences.pinyin: shuō nǐ xiǎng sǐ jiù qù ba
sentences.english: He said, “If you want to die, go ahead.”

sentences.simplified: 太史慈知道刘要不相信他，但是他真的不怕孙策，也很想和孙策打。
sentences.traditional: 太史慈知道劉要不相信他，但是他真的不怕孫策，也很想和孫策打。
sentences.pinyin: tài shǐ cí zhī dào liú yào bù xiāng xìn tā dàn shì tā zhēn de bú pà sūn cè yě hěn xiǎng hé sūn cè dǎ
sentences.english: Taishi Ci knew Liu Yao did not believe him, but he really was not afraid of Sun Ce and really wanted to fight Sun Ce.

sentences.simplified: 他心想，等打败孙策，刘要就会相信他的。
sentences.traditional: 他心想，等打敗孫策，劉要就會相信他的。
sentences.pinyin: tā xīn xiǎng děng dǎ bài sūn cè liú yào jiù huì xiāng xìn tā de
sentences.english: He thought to himself that once he defeated Sun Ce, Liu Yao would believe him.

sentences.simplified: 太史慈拿着刀，骑着马，一个人跑到孙策的军队前面。
sentences.traditional: 太史慈拿著刀，騎著馬，一個人跑到孫策的軍隊前面。
sentences.pinyin: tài shǐ cí ná zhe dāo qí zhe mǎ yí ge rén pǎo dào sūn cè de jūn duì qián miàn
sentences.english: Holding a sword and riding a horse, Taishi Ci ran in front of Sun Ce’s troops by himself.

sentences.simplified: 他大声问道：“谁是孙策？”
sentences.traditional: 他大聲問道：“誰是孫策？”
sentences.pinyin: tā dà shēng wèn dào shéi shì sūn cè
sentences.english: He asked loudly, “Which one of you is Sun Ce?”

sentences.simplified: 孙策站出来，看了看他，问：“你是谁？”
sentences.traditional: 孫策站出來，看了看他，問：“你是誰？”
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè zhàn chu lai kàn le kàn tā wèn nǐ shì shéi
sentences.english: Sun Ce stepped forward, looked at him, and asked, “Who are you?”

sentences.simplified: 太史慈说：“我叫太史慈，来打孙策！”
sentences.traditional: 太史慈說：“我叫太史慈，來打孫策！”
sentences.pinyin: tài shǐ cí shuō wǒ jiào tài shǐ cí lái dǎ sūn cè
sentences.english: Taishi Ci said, “My name is Taishi Ci. I’m here to fight Sun Ce!”

sentences.simplified: 孙策大笑：“我就是孙策，来，我和你打！我不怕你！”
sentences.traditional: 孫策大笑：“我就是孫策，來，我和你打！我不怕你！”
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè dà xiào wǒ jiù shì sūn cè lái wǒ hé nǐ dǎ wǒ bú pà nǐ
sentences.english: Sun Ce laughed loudly, “I am Sun Ce. Come, I’ll fight you! I’m not scared of you!”

sentences.simplified: 太史慈说：“我也不怕你！”
sentences.traditional: 太史慈說：“我也不怕你！”
sentences.pinyin: tài shǐ cí shuō wǒ yě bú pà nǐ
sentences.english: Taishi Ci said, “I’m not scared of you either!”

sentences.simplified: 两个人打在了一起。
sentences.traditional: 兩個人打在了一起。
sentences.pinyin: liǎng ge rén dǎ zài le yì qǐ
sentences.english: The two men fought each other.

sentences.simplified: 孙策的助手和军队都站在旁边，
sentences.traditional: 孫策的助手和軍隊都站在旁邊，
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè de zhù shǒu hé jūn duì dōu zhàn zài páng biān
sentences.english: Sun Ce’s assistants and troops were all standing nearby.

sentences.simplified: 他们不敢帮忙，因为孙策不让他们帮忙，孙策要自己和太史慈打。
sentences.traditional: 他們不敢幫忙，因為孫策不讓他們幫忙，孫策要自己和太史慈打。
sentences.pinyin: tā men bù gǎn bāng máng yīn wèi sūn cè bú ràng tā men bāng máng sūn cè yào zì jǐ hé tài shǐ cí dǎ
sentences.english: None of them dared to help because Sun Ce wouldn’t let any of them help. Sun Ce wanted to fight Taishi Ci himself.

sentences.simplified: 天气很热，他们从山上打到山下，
sentences.traditional: 天氣很熱，他們從山上打到山下，
sentences.pinyin: tiān qì hěn rè tā men cóng shān shang dǎ dào shān xià
sentences.english: It was very hot, and they fought from the top of the mountain to the base of the mountain.

sentences.simplified: 从中午打到晚上，
sentences.traditional: 從中午打到晚上，
sentences.pinyin: cóng zhōng wǔ dǎ dào wǎn shang
sentences.english: They fought from noon to evening.

sentences.simplified: 衣服坏了，头发乱了，刀也掉了，
sentences.traditional: 衣服壞了，頭髮亂了，刀也掉了，
sentences.pinyin: yī fu huài le tóu fa luàn le dāo yě diào le
sentences.english: Their clothes were ripped, their hair was messed up, and they had dropped their swords.

sentences.simplified: 但是两个人都很厉害，谁也不能打败谁。
sentences.traditional: 但是兩個人都很厲害，誰也不能打敗誰。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì liǎng ge rén dōu hěn lì hai shéi yě bù néng dǎ bài shéi
sentences.english: But both men were very formidable, and neither could defeat the other.

sentences.simplified: 孙策越打越高兴，
sentences.traditional: 孫策越打越高興，
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè yuè dǎ yuè gāo xìng
sentences.english: The more Sun Ce fought, the happier he became.

sentences.simplified: 他拉着太史慈的衣服，大笑着说：“你这个人真有意思！”
sentences.traditional: 他拉著太史慈的衣服，大笑著說：“你這個人真有意思！”
sentences.pinyin: tā lā zhe tài shǐ cí de yī fu dà xiào zhe shuō nǐ zhè ge rén zhēn yǒu yì si
sentences.english: He pulled Taishi Ci’s clothes, laughed loudly, and said, “You’re a funny guy!”

sentences.simplified: 太史慈也拉着孙策的头发，大声说：“你这个人真没意思！”
sentences.traditional: 太史慈也拉著孫策的頭髮，大聲說：“你這個人真沒意思！”
sentences.pinyin: tài shǐ cí yě lā zhe sūn cè de tóu fa dà shēng shuō nǐ zhè ge rén zhēn méi yì si
sentences.english: Taishi Ci also pulled Sun Ce’s hair and said loudly, “You’re not funny at all!”

sentences.simplified: 孙策笑得更大声了，他觉得太史慈太有意思了。
sentences.traditional: 孫策笑得更大聲了，他覺得太史慈太有意思了。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè xiào de gèng dà shēng le tā jué de tài shǐ cí tài yǒu yì si le
sentences.english: Sun Ce laughed even more loudly. He thought that Taishi Ci was very funny.

sentence_translations: A Young Soldier
When Liu Yao saw Sun Ce, his face went pale. He was so scared that he fell off his horse.
The assistants did not help him and immediately ran away. Liu Yao has no choice but to run away with the assistants.
They ran back to the outside of the city of Qu’a, taking some men with them, with Sun Ce’s men following behind.
Liu Yao still wanted to run when someone stepped forward and said, “Lord, you must not run any longer.
Sun Ce doesn’t have many men. We can fight them. Don’t be scared!”
Liu Yao’s eyes widened. He asked, “Who are you? Why don’t I know who you are?”
That person said, “Lord, my name is Taishi Ci. I am a young soldier.”
“A young soldier?” Liu Yao wanted to laugh: “A young soldier, and you still dare to fight Sun Ce? Do you want to die?”
Taishi Ci said, “Lord, I do dare fight Sun Ce. I’m not scared of him!”
Liu Yao didn’t want to hear this. His home was already gone, and he was extremely tired.
He said, “If you want to die, go ahead.”
Taishi Ci knew Liu Yao did not believe him, but he really was not afraid of Sun Ce and really wanted to fight Sun Ce.
He thought to himself that once he defeated Sun Ce, Liu Yao would believe him.
Holding a sword and riding a horse, Taishi Ci ran in front of Sun Ce’s troops by himself.
He asked loudly, “Which one of you is Sun Ce?”
Sun Ce stepped forward, looked at him, and asked, “Who are you?”
Taishi Ci said, “My name is Taishi Ci. I’m here to fight Sun Ce!”
Sun Ce laughed loudly, “I am Sun Ce. Come, I’ll fight you! I’m not scared of you!”
Taishi Ci said, “I’m not scared of you either!”
The two men fought each other.
Sun Ce’s assistants and troops were all standing nearby.
None of them dared to help because Sun Ce wouldn’t let any of them help. Sun Ce wanted to fight Taishi Ci himself.
It was very hot, and they fought from the top of the mountain to the base of the mountain.
They fought from noon to evening.
Their clothes were ripped, their hair was messed up, and they had dropped their swords.
But both men were very formidable, and neither could defeat the other.
The more Sun Ce fought, the happier he became.
He pulled Taishi Ci’s clothes, laughed loudly, and said, “You’re a funny guy!”
Taishi Ci also pulled Sun Ce’s hair and said loudly, “You’re not funny at all!”
Sun Ce laughed even more loudly. He thought that Taishi Ci was very funny.
